project.title: Assessment of Antimicrobial Resistance Genes and Pathobiome Diversity in Domestic Wastewater in a Tropical Country
project.description: This study evaluated the removal capacity of ARGs in a WWTP in Cartago, Costa Rica, and investigated its role as a potential reservoir for these genes.
